title: iOS MVP Builds
meta: A focused first version of your iPhone app, built fast so you can test your idea with real users. From $350, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: iOS MVP build, test your idea with real users
overview: An MVP is the smallest app that proves your idea. We agree one core problem and the three or four features that solve it, cut everything else, and build a working iOS app you can put in front of real people through TestFlight. You get the source code, a simple way to read feedback and a list of what to build next.

pkgs.blurb: One core feature, working end to end and ready to test.
A testable product with accounts, data and basic analytics.
A launch-ready first version with payments and store submission.

faq: What makes an MVP different from a full app?
An MVP has one clear job. We build only the flow that tests your idea, not every feature on your wish list. If it works, you can extend it with our app build or feature work services.
Can you help me decide which features to build?
Yes. We start with a short written scope where we cut the list down to what the first users need. You approve it before we write any code, so the build stays inside the delivery window.
Will the MVP need rebuilding later?
No. We use the same Swift and SwiftUI foundations as a full app, with a clean structure, so you can keep building on it. Any shortcuts we took are noted in the handover.
Do I need a design first?
No. If you have sketches or a design, we follow them. If not, we design simple, clean screens that follow Apple's interface guidelines, and you approve them before the build.
